utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just bring whatever you want fixed, and I’ll keep reminding folks about the repair drive at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll bring whatever needs fixing. Thanks for keeping people posted about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can make the sign-up list and check in with a few neighbors about what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll put the list together and start checking in with neighbors, then we can compare notes on the addresses and repairs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word and see who can pitch in for the repair drive. If I hear back from anyone, I’ll let you know who can make it and when.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just let me know who’s coming and what spots need fixing, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll keep you posted on who’s coming and what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’d start with the broken step, the loose railing, and that uneven sidewalk patch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can take a look at the broken step first when I get there around 6. If you point me to the tools, I’ll jump in where it’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — I’ll point you to the tools when you get here around 6. That broken step is the main one, and if you have time the railing and sidewalk patch need a look too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Kira — spare tools, screws, batteries, or anything else you can part with would really help. I’ve already got a little list going with tools, tape, and a few extra bulbs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this is still happening today, right? And what time and place should I drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it’s still happening today — just drop things off at my place this afternoon. If you can, bring whatever spare tools, screws, batteries, or anything else you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it sounds like people are really pitching in—last I heard, they’re bringing tools and spare parts. I’d stop by if you can; they might still need a few useful things.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my wrench and a screwdriver set, and I’m happy to start wherever you need me. Just tell me what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Gus—wrenches and screwdriver sets are always useful. I’d check in at the repair drive and see if they need you to start on anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: What time are you thinking for the repair drive? I need to make sure it doesn’t clash with school drop-off or pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: How about 6:00? I’ll keep it after school drop-off and before pickup, and we can focus on the top safety repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 6:00 should work for me, as long as we stay on the safety repairs first. I’ll plan around that and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What time is the repair drive, and where should I bring the items?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s lock in a firm drop-off time first, and then send me the hauling list. Once I have that, I can tell you what I can fit in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — what time should I drop things off, and where should I bring the hauling list?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, quite a bit—I’m pretty sure we’ve got a few more things to fix up now, though I’d have to check the list again. Want me to go have a look?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please—if you could check the list again, that would help a lot. I’ll be there when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ll go check the list and come right back.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — tell me where you want me to start, and I can bring my wrench and screwdriver set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be amazing—tools are exactly what we need. If you can bring them by, I can help sort the supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I’ll bring them by. Just point me to the supply table and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 3 still works for me — I’ll bring the tools then.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — 3 works. I’ll spread the word and make sure folks know to bring anything blocking walkways, broken steps, loose railings, or exposed wires.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll bring the tools and help wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—let’s start with the broken step first, then the loose railing, and finish with the uneven sidewalk patch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds like a good order, Mina—I’ll note the broken step first, then the railing, and the sidewalk patch last.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, Rosa—can you mark those as our top three so we can tell the others what to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—point me to the tools, and I’ll jump in on the fence panel or the hose bib.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect — the tools are over by the garage. Let’s start with the fence panel, then we can check the hose bib if we have time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’m heading over there now and I’ll tackle the fence panel first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still happening today, right? And drop-off is by 2 with you picking up the tools after?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s still on for today, and please drop the tools off by 2 — I’ll swing by to pick them up after.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — thanks for confirming.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—let’s put broken steps, loose railings, and anything blocking walkways at the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll make sure those are the top priorities when I spread the word, and I’ll pass along any names and timing as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Jules. Please let me know the names and timing as soon as you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can make a simple sign-up list and check in with a few neighbors about what needs fixing. I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Mara. I’m set for 3 and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo — 3 works for me, and thanks for bringing the tools. I’ll have the sign-up list ready and I’ll check in with the neighbors before then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please go check—I’d love to know what’s still needed. I can bring the screws and batteries by later, and I’m happy to sort supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that works for me—send me the exact drop-off time and the hauling list, and I’ll see what I can fit in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing—I’ll ask for the drop-off time and hauling list, then send it over.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I’ll show you the spots once we get started.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I'll bring the tape and rags. Just point me to the spots when we start.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the full list of confirmed details before I commit, so could you remind me what’s set for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m still waiting on the final confirmed details too, but I can bring my wrench and a screwdriver set once you have the list. Just let me know where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — that helps. I’ll hold off until we’ve got the final confirmed details, then I’ll let you know where to start.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need to make sure it doesn’t clash with school drop-off or pickup. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m thinking late morning, after drop-off and before pickup if that works better. I can shift it a bit to fit your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late morning should work better for me, as long as it’s not too close to pickup. Send me the final time once it’s set, and I’ll do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it’s shaping up nicely—people are bringing tools and spare parts, so it might really make a difference.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful to hear, Tess. It’s now on Sunday at the community center, so I’ll keep folks updated and make sure everyone knows where to go.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Sunday at the community center works—I'll spread the word. Sounds like a lot of neighbors are pitching in, which is lovely.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’d start with the broken step, the loose railing, and that uneven sidewalk patch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, got it — broken step, loose railing, and the sidewalk patch. I can go take a look at the list and help out where I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks Oren — if you can check those three first, we’ll have a solid start on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It starts at 10 a.m. over at the community center parking lot—just bring whatever you’ve got, and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll bring my wrench and screwdriver set. If you hear they need anything specific, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll pass along any specific needs as soon as I hear them. Thanks for bringing the tools!
